info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: “ rADokarmakAdeva vfdDAveva . (ga. sU. divAdO) evakAraH BinnakramaH . rADokarmakAdeva Syan . udAharaRamAha vfdDAviti . yanmahyamaparADyati . druhyati ityarTaH . virADyantaM kzameta kaH . dfhyatAm ityarTaH . rADyatyodanaH . sidDyatItyarTaH . kfzRAya rADyati . dEvaM paryAlocayatItyarTaH . dEvasya DAtvarTentarBAvAt jIvatyAdivat akarmakatvam “ iti sidDAntakOmudI . ' rADnoti saMsidDyarTe SnO , rADyet vfdDAvakarmakAt ' (Slo. 122) iti devaH . atra prayuktasya evakArasya viviDAH arTAH kfdantarUpamAlAyAM darSitAH . ' asya tu sidDidrohadEvaparyAlocanAdayorTAH ' iti DA.kA.vyAKyA (2.63) .

info.name: karmakatvam
info.note: rAD-DAtoH vizaye divAdigaRe 4.163 ityatra rADo'karmakAd vfdDAveva iti gaRasUtraM pAWyate . divAdigaRe pAWitaH rAD-DAtuH akarmakaH eva svIkaraRIyaH iti asya gaRasUtrasya arTaH .
